h:
这是 ComfyUI_PuLID_Flux_ll 人脸传输的工作流程。

如果您想生成图像，保持输入的脸部图像不变，并根据提示生成其余部分，它会非常有用，但它不允许您更改脸部的相机角度。

o.en:
Here is a working workflow of ComfyUI_PuLID_Flux_ll face transfer.

It works great if you want to generate images keeping the input face image as it is and generating the rest of the part as per your prompt, but it doesn't allow you to change the camera angle of face.
